keywords-statement.comment: M4a: includes the M3a-M3e browser-step keywords (open/click/.../stub) and their sub-clause words (on/to/onto/dialog/new/tab/frame/respond), catching up parser.ts's STATEMENT_KEYWORDS. M4b adds `mask` (the `mask <locator>` snapshot-masking clause). M28 adds `log` (M27 added it to STATEMENT_KEYWORDS but never caught this independent copy up — PLAN_LOG_LSP.md). M33 adds the M29-M32 load-testing leading keywords `ramp`/`over`/`threshold`/`cleanup`/`think` (all now written inside an ordinary `test` body; FS-05 renamed `think` to `pause`, and `think` stays listed here so the migration diagnostic's own line still highlights). M50 removed the standalone `scenario` keyword (D93) — a `test` is a load test whenever it contains a `ramp to …` line. Phase 1b (D97) adds the 4 new workload keywords `hold`/`step`/`spike`/`run` and their sub-clause words `for`/`across`/`per`. Phase 2b (D105-D107) adds `parallel`/`sequential`, the optional per-test concurrency header modifier (same slot as `retry N`, legal on any test). D127 (PLAN_DISCOVERY_EXCLUDE.md) adds `exclude`, a top-level tflw.config directive. FS-04 keeps `uncheck` listed for the same reason `think` is kept: it is retired and always a diagnostic, but a TextMate grammar has no error concept, and leaving a retired word uncolored would make the offending line read as broken text rather than as a keyword the LSP is underlining. M133 (D24b catch-up) adds the pentest arc's config-dialect vocabulary — `authorized`/`target`/`reason` (M128b/D291's `authorized target "<url>" reason "<text>"`), the indented `probe mutating` sub-clause (M130b/D311), and `privileged`, the `session` header modifier in the same slot as `oauth2` (D307/D310). This grammar is contributed for `tflw.config` as well as `.tflw` (package.json's `extensions`/`filenames`), which is why config keywords belong here. M136b (D427/D427a) moved the config dialect out of this grammar entirely: `tflw.config` now has its own language id and its own `source.tflw.config` grammar, which includes this one and adds the eighteen words only a config uses. M133-01's remaining words live there, not here, because `key`/`web`/`destination` are ordinary identifiers in a .tflw file and this list colours .tflw files. M142 closes M136b-01 and B5-09 together: `honoring` joins this list, `spider` joins it from M137f, `csv`/`pdf` join keywords-subject and `password`/`uuid` join keywords-generator — the six words the LSP paints and this grammar did not, found by comparing the two paths with a program (packages/vscode/test/grammar.test.ts) rather than by a fifth hand audit. `up`/`method`/`schema` are deliberately NOT here: they are plausible ordinary identifiers, neither path paints them, and both now say so in semanticTokens.ts's DELIBERATELY_UNCOLOURED (D442). That test fails if this list and the LSP's ever disagree again, in either direction. M134a adds `oversized`/`traversal`, the two further `probe` sub-clauses D311 predicted would land as siblings (D372) — caught up in the milestone that ships them, which is the correction to what M133 found here. M137c adds the crawl's four words — `crawl`, `seed`, `openapi`, `traffic` (D432/D450) — in the milestone that ships them, for the same reason. `exclude` was already here. M137g adds `ciphers`, the fourth `probe` sub-clause (D485), in its own milestone as well — that is now three milestones running, which is the M133 correction holding rather than a coincidence.
keywords-statement.name: keyword.control.tflw

percentile.comment: M33: `p50`/`p90`/`p95`/`p99`/… (M29 `threshold p95 duration is less than 800ms`, D24a) — a dynamic ident, not fixed vocabulary (parser.ts's `parseThresholdDecl` accepts any `p` followed by 1-2 digits), so it needs its own regex rather than joining `keywords-subject`'s literal wordlist.
percentile.name: support.type.tflw

keywords-subject.comment: M4a: includes the M3a/M3e locator-noun and `page` subjects (button/field/list/css/xpath/page), catching up parser.ts's SUBJECT_KEYWORDS. M128b adds `response` (the security-scan subject). M33 adds the M29 load-testing metric/target nouns `users`/`rps` (`ramp to N users|rps over …`) and `error`/`rate` (`threshold error rate is …`). Phase 1b adds `iterations`/`user` (`run N iterations per user across M users`).
keywords-subject.name: support.type.tflw

keywords-matcher.comment: M4a: includes `was`/`made` (M3d `was made`) and `no`/`a11y`/`violations`/severity words (M3e `has no [<severity>] a11y violations`). M4b adds `snapshot` (`matches snapshot "<name>"`). M128b adds `security` (`has no [<severity>] security violations`). M133 adds `authorization` (`has no [<severity>] authorization violations`, M130b/D304) — the arc's second scan, which M130b never caught up to this independent copy or to semanticTokens.ts's; `violations` and the four severity words were already shared with a11y and needed nothing. M134a adds `input`/`handling` (`has no [<severity>] input handling violations`, D366) — the arc's third scan, and the first whose scan word is two words: the lexer has no hyphen in an identifier, so the plan's `input-handling` spelling would have lexed as three tokens.
keywords-matcher.name: keyword.operator.word.tflw
